sources.name: New Canadians Centre - Peterborough & Cobourg
sources.notes: Confirmed live 2026-08-26 - WordPress + The Events Calendar. Settlement agency serving Peterborough and Cobourg since 1979 (also administers the Peterborough Immigration Partnership). Feed includes Summer Coffee and Conversation Group, ESL/LINC-adjacent programming - strong practical anchor.

sources.name: The Boro (Downtown Peterborough BIA events)
sources.notes: Confirmed live 2026-08-26 - WordPress + The Events Calendar, run by the Downtown Peterborough Business Improvement Area (formerly peterboroughbia.com/theboro.ca rebrand). Feed includes Movies at the Park and other downtown programming - strong social anchor, likely covers Ribfest/farmers-market-type events directly so no manual festival entries needed.

sources.name: Trent International - Upcoming Events
sources.notes: Single best-fit source for this city (international student orientation, TISA - Trent International Students' Association, weekly recruiter Q&As) but trentu.ca is Drupal with a JSON:API that only exposes node--callout / node--page / node--promo / node--testimonial content types - no node--event type, so events live in a module the API doesn't expose. No tribe/sqs/communico/ical route found either. TISA's own events are on Facebook (facebook.com/tisatrentu/events) - not a stable feed source.

sources.name: Trent University Spiritual Affairs / Multi-Faith Network
sources.notes: Volunteer chaplains/community liaisons across faith traditions, multi-faith room in LEC 202, holds events on spirituality/identity/equity themes. Same Drupal/no-event-API limitation as trent-international above - no feed found. Best current spiritual-stream candidate for Trent, needs hand-entry once specific dated events are announced.

sources.name: Fleming College - International Education / Orientation Events
sources.notes: WordPress site but /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events 404s - no Events Calendar plugin active. Hosts International Orientation and the Multicultural Showcase (games, music, dance, martial arts) each year but no feed found to pull exact dates - re-probe or hand-enter closer to term start.

sources.name: Peterborough Public Library
sources.notes: Runs Springshare LibCal, not Communico/libnet like Hamilton/Kingston - a different vendor, not one of our parser kinds. The old calendar.ptbolibrary.ca host (same URL pattern as the Communico cities) now fails TLS handshake entirely (SSL_ILLEGAL_MESSAGE / unrecognized_name) - looks decommissioned, the library migrated to LibCal. LibCal has a documented public API (api.libcal.com) that could be a future parser target.

sources.name: Welcome Peterborough (newcomer settlement info portal)
sources.notes: WordPress site (settlement/newcomer information hub - housing, ESL, services) but /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events 404s, no Events Calendar plugin. Mostly static resource pages rather than a dated-events site; low priority to re-probe.

sources.name: Peterborough & the Kawarthas Tourism - Calendar of Events
sources.notes: Not Squarespace (the ?format=json probe returned normal HTML) - looks like a custom/Umbraco CMS (class="usn" marker). No feed found. Lists Peterborough Folk Festival (Aug 13-16), Peterborough Musicfest (Del Crary Park, Wed/Sat through mid-Aug), Kawartha Ribfest, Kawartha Autumn Studio Tour (Sept 26) - The Boro's own feed likely surfaces the downtown subset of these already.

sources.name: The Kawarthas Tourism (thekawarthas.ca)
sources.notes: Cloudflare-protected (403 on a bare probe, 'Attention Required!' challenge page) - could not confirm platform or feed. Re-probe with browser headers/session if this city gets a second pass.

sources.name: St. Paul's Presbyterian Church - Newcomers Mission
sources.notes: Newcomers Mission (started 2017) helps Arabic-speaking and other newcomers with ESL classes, navigating social services, translation, and friendship-building - explicit newcomer framing. WordPress (Avada theme) but no tribe route. Standing Sunday 10am service (in-person/online/YouTube); the only dated Mission item found (a June 1, 2026 update presentation) had already passed by the 2026-08-26 build - left with an empty manual event list rather than fabricating forward dates.
